get.description: GET /employee/by-line-manager/{id} and GET /employee/by-hrd-manager/{id} do NOT exist as separate routes - use the lineManagerId and hrManagerId query parameters on this endpoint instead. Both are array parameters (repeat the key for multiple values), combinable with the other filters listed here. A line manager caller without office-wide entitlement may only pass a lineManagerId inside their own chain (otherwise 400); omitting it does not mean "everyone" for such a caller - the server stamps their own id. Roles for the manager filters: ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_LINE_MANAGER, ROLE_PAYROLL_MANAGER, ROLE_VISITOR_MANAGEMENT_ADMIN, ROLE_VISITOR_MANAGEMENT_RECEPTIONIST, or a location manager - and the office must hold module MODULE_2001.

post.summary: Apply Manual Entry / Missing Punch / Field Visit / Alternate VP
post.description: Missing Punch is type: 2 (not a separate API) - requires missingPunchType ("device" or "mobile"). type: 1=Manual Entry, 2=Missing Punch, 3=Field Visit, 4=App Punch (no approval notifications sent), 5=Alternate VP. If the employee has no approvers configured, the row auto-accepts and forwards immediately; a forward failure deletes the row and returns 503 (retry, do not treat as applied).

parameters.description: marks the row as captured offline

exitTime.description: epoch ms - required for types 1, 3, 5. If <= entryTime, one day is added (night shift), except type 5 where an inverted pair is refused.

startDate.description: optional; if absent, derived from entryTime for types 3 and 5 only

missingPunchType.description: required for type 2 - "device" or "mobile"; any other value is a 400

area.description: required for type 2 + "mobile" (location name), and for type 3

coveredByName.description: required for type 5; free-text name, no id counterpart

forceApproval.description: defaults false. Sent as boolean on write; returned as a STRING in the response - do not reuse one type for both directions

get.summary: Unified Pending-Approval Count (Leave + Late + Manual Entry)
get.description: Send the trailing slash. Replaces the non-existent GET /application/pending-list - this returns a COUNT, not rows. Counts every application across leave_log, late_approval_log and manual_entry (incl. missing punch, field visit, Alternate VP) where the caller is either approver and still pending. Roles: any authenticated account - the approver is the token holder, no parameters. The count is cached in Redis and invalidated on the caller's own approve/reject - a decision made by someone else may not be reflected immediately; re-fetch the per-type lists before acting on a row. To build a combined inbox, call the three per-type pending lists and merge client-side: GET /employee/profile/manual/approver (manualEntryApplications[]), GET /late-approval-management/approval-requests/{yourOwnEmployeeId} (lateApprovalApplications[]), GET /remaining-leave/approvers/{approverEmployeeId} (leaveApplications[]).

get.description: Returns every sub-department across ALL offices the caller is entitled to, not just their own. Archived rows (status: -1) are never returned by any combination of parameters - once archived, a sub-department is invisible here, though employees may still carry historical references to it. The list is served from a Redis cache with a database fallback that only fires when the result is completely empty - for a multi-office account, treat a suspiciously short list as possibly incomplete rather than authoritative, and re-fetch. Roles: ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_LINE_MANAGER, or a location manager - this route does NOT exclude ROLE_VIEW_ONLY, since it is office metadata a read-only account legitimately needs to filter reports.

post.description: There is no PUT and no DELETE verb - this one route does both. Every field is optional, but at least one must be present or you get 400 "Invalid request". To delete, send {"status": -1} (archives, removed from every listing); {"status": 0} deactivates without archiving. WARNING: setting status to -1 OR 0 unsets that sub-department on every employee assigned to it (UPDATE employee SET sub_department_id = NULL WHERE sub_department_id = {id}) BEFORE applying the status change. This is NOT reversible by setting status back to 1 - the employee links are gone and must be reassigned via POST /employee/updateBatchSubDepartment/{subDepartmentId}. Capture the membership list before calling this if you need to restore it. Roles: ROLE_ADMIN, not ROLE_VIEW_ONLY - a company admin may update any sub-department inside their company; anyone else is restricted to their own office (else 403). Unknown id => 404.
